factProposals.value: Past reviews are kept in an embedded LanceDB vector database stored as local files outside SQL Server; retrieval filters to the submission's Stress Test before ranking by cosine similarity.
Text embeddings are computed locally with fastembed (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, 384 dimensions); no external embedding service or key is used, and the model is downloaded once on first use.

A historical case is one review round: a student's ##Critique## submission and the next reviewer comment marked ##FeedbackGiven## or ##Approved## in the same thread; a thread with a resubmission gives several cases.

Every AI evaluation carries a history outcome the reviewer can read: found (with the similar cases), none_found, or unavailable with the reason; it is also recorded in the audit trail as history_retrieved.

Historical examples are given to Claude only as labelled examples in the user message; the rule module stays the system prompt, only the stage's rule ids are accepted, and severities come from the module.

decisions.statement: Return the top 10 similar cases by default, configurable from 1 to 15 with HISTORY_TOP_K.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-28: meets the acceptance line 'top 5-10'; with 15 approved threads per Stress Test indexed, a fixed top 15 would have returned every case

decisions.statement: Use LanceDB embedded (files under a git-ignored folder) as the vector database, behind a VectorIndex interface.
decisions.rationale: user asked to follow the finished stories, which all store app data as local git-ignored files behind an interface; no server to run; another engine can be swapped in as one class

decisions.statement: Compute embeddings locally instead of calling a paid embedding API.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-09-28: free, and student text never leaves the machine

decisions.statement: Cut each past submission and past feedback to 600 characters in the Claude prompt (2,000 in the index).
decisions.rationale: 10 full cases would add about 10k input tokens per stage and push many submissions over the 20k input limit into manual resolution

decisions.statement: An index that was never built is reported as unavailable, not as 'no similar cases'.
decisions.rationale: a setup mistake must not look like an empty history to the reviewer

limitations.statement: Retrieval does not filter by rule id: historical reviewer feedback is not tagged with rule ids, so a case is a whole submission and its whole answer.
Only the history extract is indexed; completed reviews from this app are not added yet (STORY-007).
Screenshots and attached files are indexed only as their [image: name] / [file: name] markers; their content is not embedded.
The embedding model reads about the first 512 tokens of a submission; longer submissions are matched on their beginning.
Evaluations stored before this story keep no history; a replay returns the stored result unchanged.
